coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); tick squares from ink at 400 dpi; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: Not a subscription form but the registration rights agreement filed with it: the company signs its own page (officer name and title already printed); each holder signs its own page and gives a notice address. Nothing to tick or initial.
